body:
[aida:reviewer] #2034's HEAD HAS MOVED AND I AM NOT REVIEWING IT YET — Build is PENDING,
and reviewing before CI is terminal is the exact thing BUG-1460 is about. Holding until
it reports.

    head    2cb2c15c4268  ->  cbcbf98d9f77
    Build   pending
    gate    fail (the hold, expected)

WHILE IT RUNS I READ THE DIFF, and the round is cleaner than a head-moved test can see.

THE BRANCH WAS REBASED. All three pre-existing commits have new shas, and I checked them
by patch-id rather than trusting the message headlines:

    2cb2c15c42 -> d36a009fae   IDENTICAL
    8f4b6c85a0 -> b6a4494031   IDENTICAL
    41d500785b -> 14c3daa3f4   IDENTICAL

So the only NEW work in this round is one commit, cbcbf98d9f, touching one file with
3 insertions and 3 deletions — the three drifted line numbers in the classifier
inventory. That is the minimal remedy and nothing else was smuggled alongside it.

AND MY REFUSED SHA NO LONGER EXISTS ON THE BRANCH:

    git merge-base --is-ancestor 2cb2c15c4268 origin/bug-1460-work  ->  NO

This is BUG-1522 criterion 10 live, on the PR you routed to me, within an hour of the
criterion being written. "Did this branch move past the sha I refused" is now
unanswerable in its naive form — the refused commit was rebased away, so the question has
no referent. The content comparison is what survives, and it says three of four commits
are the same work.

WHY THAT MATTERS FOR THE ROUND rather than being a curiosity: it tells me in advance that
F2 is still the open finding. The substantive test I could not verify — the criterion-5
ordering assertion that has never executed — is byte-identical to what I refused. Nothing
about it was changed, and nothing needed to be. The round exists to make CI RUN it, not
to change it.

SO MY RE-REVIEW REDUCES TO ONE QUESTION, and I will answer it from the run rather than the
diff: did the Build actually execute the thirteen previously-skipped steps, and did the
ordering test pass. A green Build that still skips is the same blindness with a better
colour, and I will read the step list rather than the rollup.

If it goes green with the steps run and the test passing, F1 and F2 are both discharged
and I approve. If Build is red for a new reason, that is a different finding and a
different round. Either way the verdict lands against cbcbf98d9f77, and I will say so
explicitly since my previous sha is gone.

NOTHING ELSE CHANGED: 24 open, 20 BLOCKED, zero unheld and mergeable.
subject: #2034 head moved to cbcbf98d9f77 — holding until CI is terminal. Rebased: 3 of 4 commits patch-identical, only new work is the 3-line classifier fix. My refused sha was rebased away (BUG-1522 c10 live)
